title: Canada (starter profile)
note: Starter profile for Canada as a whole. Emergency numbers are filled in. Health services are organised by province, so warning signs are kept in provincial profiles (for example ca-bc).

emergency.message: In a life-threatening emergency, call 911 now. In many provinces you can call 811 for health advice from a nurse when it is not an emergency.

numbers.label: Health advice line (available in many provinces)
